root_cause_label: Wrong Working Directory / Artifact Placement (Edited & Built in /app/src Instead of /app) + No Finish Call
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly identified the needed changes (gfortran, -O3) but applied them by editing /app/src/Makefile in-place and building in /app/src, never creating the required /app/Makefile or placing artifacts in /app as the task specified, and then issued no completion signal.
t_err_evidence: Step 3: Agent edits /app/src/Makefile via str_replace instead of creating /app/Makefile; the task requires all actions to be based in /app and objective 1 is to modify /app/Makefile, but the agent never copies src/Makefile to /app first.
t_commit_evidence: Once the agent edits /app/src/Makefile (step 3) without creating /app/Makefile, the required artifact /app/Makefile is never generated; with only 3 steps remaining and all subsequent actions staying in /app/src, the failing outcome is locked in.
trigger_explanation: After exploring /app and seeing that /app/src contains the Makefile (step 1), the agent implicitly assumes it should edit the existing /app/src/Makefile in-place, without recognizing that the task requires creating a new /app/Makefile (copying from src and modifying it there). No verification of the task's working-directory constraint was done before editing.
